findings.claim: CAH is at the 52-week high on below-normal participation with a bearish divergence already showing. Two deciders nominated it as a momentum name. The divergence and the thin volume are a fired caution that the cases must answer in their own terms.

findings.claim: BTSG was nominated by a trend-template seat and by a Wyckoff seat, yet the moving averages are not stacked. The 50-day sits below the 100-day. That is higher-timeframe context a trend-template read must explain, alongside a bearish divergence at the same time.
findings.evidence: BTSG ma_50 61.24; ma_100 63.47; ma_200 55.71; div_state BEARISH; div_bear_count 1; structure 87.4; structure_shift BULLISH_BOS. Seats minervini (3), wyckoff (2).

findings.claim: XNCR sits at its 52-week high with the strongest relative-strength rank in the nominated set, yet two of the five oscillators confirm a bearish divergence, the highest count among nominated names. Volume participation is the weakest of the room's high-flyers. The case leans on rs_rank_pct, a field with no measured forward-return separation in this packet.
findings.evidence: XNCR pct_from_52w_high 0.0; rs_rank_pct 99.67; div_state BEARISH; div_bear_count 2; lens_warnings 2; day_vol 0.63; ma_50 26.67 vs ma_200 17.72. Seat seow (3).
